name: EscapeNET
description:
About This Game

THE NARRATIVE:

Welcome to EscapeNET. Humanity has fallen. AI rules. And you are its experiment. The AI watches, and adapts — every mistake fuels its knowledge.

GAMEPLAY:

EscapeNET is a multiplayer co-op light horror experience where 2–4 players are thrown into a network of deadly chambers designed to test every aspect of human skill, puzzle solving, strategy, and survival. Survive deadly puzzles, navigate unseen dangers with drone-assisted teammates, and compete against your friends in high-stakes arenas — all while racing against time.

One wrong move can mean instant deletion. 

You can’t hide from the code.
short_desc: Survive in first person, deadly AI-controlled chambers in EscapeNET, where players must cooperate as humans and drones, solve deadly puzzles, and face off in high-stakes PvP arenas — all under relentless time pressure.
